text: HUGO BOSS AG is a Frankfurt-listed stock corporation with a concentrated shareholder base: Frasers Group plc holds approximately 48% of voting rights, and Marzotto-family entities (PFC S.p.A./Zignago Holding S.p.A.) hold about 14%, with roughly 38% in free float. No state shareholder.

source.name: HUGO BOSS Group: Shareholder structure
source.quote: Frasers Group plc holds approximately 48% of the voting rights, while PFC S.p.A. and Zignago Holding S.p.A., both controlled by the Marzotto family, collectively own around 14%
